records.inherited_baseline: conquest-era extraction and dependent status preceded more regular multi-group administration

records.field_coverage: Mongol, Han, and Muslim participation plus partial dependent-status relief, bounded by legal-office hierarchy

records.inherited_baseline: the dynasty lacked an equivalently integrated cross-regional observation, instrument, and adopted-calendar chain

records.field_coverage: astronomy and calendrical science from cross-regional observation through instruments and state use

records.era_relative_difficulty: adjudicated against MATURE_PRINT_MULTILINGUAL_AND_CROSS_REGIONAL, not raw copies or reader counts

records.inherited_baseline: the Mongol polity lacked a stable indigenous administrative writing system in routine state use
records.contemporary_feasible_frontier: a steppe empire could borrow neighboring scripts, but institutionalizing one across administration required direct political adoption
records.background_trend: Uighur scribal expertise pre-existed; the attributable increment is Chinggis Khan's adoption and state use of the adapted script
records.attributable_change: 命塔塔统阿以畏兀儿字书写蒙古语，并用于诏令、文书与后续国家行政，形成蒙古政权稳定书写体系

records.durability_and_handoff: the script remained a principal Mongolian writing system across successor regimes

counterevidence.summary: script form derived from Uighur models; technical authorship is not credited to the ruler

records.inherited_baseline: the Yuan state had no stable empire-wide examination route actually producing entrants before the restoration
records.contemporary_feasible_frontier: a mature imperial bureaucracy could organize regional examination access, while ethnic quotas and elite preparation continued to constrain equality
records.background_trend: earlier proposals existed, but the realized multi-region examinations and admissions belong to the Renzong window
records.attributable_change: 延祐年间恢复并实际举行科举，形成多区域乡试—会试—殿试链，实际录取进士并持续为后续统治提供制度化人才流动入口
records.field_coverage: multi-region examination participation and a realized entry route into office, constrained by ethnic quotas and limited cohort size
records.durability_and_handoff: the examination route continued after the initial 1315 cohort and became a durable Yuan personnel channel

counterevidence.summary: ethnic quota asymmetry and limited cohort size cap the band at LOW

records.inherited_baseline: 窝阔台时期燕京已设小型蒙古—汉文中央学校，但尚无世祖朝以八思巴字为核心的蒙古国子学、地方蒙古字学和对应翻译/教学任职通道
records.contemporary_feasible_frontier: 统一帝国可以扩充中央与地方学校，但民族文字专门教育仍受生源、语言难度和官僚需求限制
records.background_trend: 蒙古贵族学习汉文及畏兀儿文早已有之；只消费忽必烈窗口新设蒙古国子学、蒙古字学和实际任职出口
records.attributable_change: 至元年间设蒙古国子学，选蒙古、汉人百官及怯薛官员子弟学习新蒙古字与经史，并在地方设蒙古字学；学习八思巴字者可进入通事、译史和蒙古字教师等实际岗位，形成新的语言教育—任职通道
records.field_coverage: central Mongolian academy plus local character schools and specialist office exits, with small cohorts and strong elite weighting
records.durability_and_handoff: schools and script education continued through Yuan, but major expansion in student numbers belongs mainly to later reigns
records.cross_scene_replication: central academy, local schools and translator/teacher office routes

counterevidence.summary: an earlier central school existed under Ögedei and Kublai-era cohorts remained small; these cap the result at CIV2-HIGH

records.inherited_baseline: 畏兀儿体蒙古文已是蒙古国家文字，尚无可以统一转写多种帝国语言的新字体系
records.contemporary_feasible_frontier: 统一多语帝国具备组织文字创制和官方推广能力，但真正替代既有书写传统需要广泛社会采用
records.background_trend: 多语行政需求是时代背景；只消费忽必烈命八思巴造字、1269年颁行和随后的国家教育与文书采用
records.attributable_change: 命八思巴创制新蒙古字，至元六年颁行并要求官方文书使用；八思巴字被用于蒙古语、汉语等多种语言并进入官学、印章和行政文本，形成持续近百年的国家文字实验
records.field_coverage: official multilingual writing, schools, seals and administrative documents across the empire, with weak popular adoption
records.durability_and_handoff: state use continued across Yuan but the script failed to displace Uighur-Mongolian or Chinese writing and disappeared rapidly after the dynasty
records.cross_scene_replication: official documents, education and multilingual transcription

records.inherited_baseline: 成吉思汗时期已采用畏兀儿文字行政，但华北新征服区尚无蒙古统治下稳定的中央儒学教育层和面向广域儒士的国家选试、身份优免链
records.contemporary_feasible_frontier: 征服战争尚未结束、人口流离和奴役普遍的背景下，建立小型中央学校并组织跨地域数千人选试已是高难度教育与人才通道建设
records.background_trend: 金代儒学传统和中原士人资源是继承背景；只消费窝阔台接受耶律楚材建议后新设教育、选试及实际身份结果
records.attributable_change: 1233年前后燕京设国子学，首批约三十六名蒙古子弟学习汉文、蒙古文等，后又纳入汉官子弟；1237—1238年接受耶律楚材建议在中原诸路举行戊戌选试，四千余儒士中选，并形成儒户优免，其中部分被俘为奴儒生获得身份改善，构成从教育供给到广域选试、身份流动的结构性新通道
records.field_coverage: small central Mongol-Han learner cohort plus multi-region selection of more than four thousand Confucian scholars and durable scholar-household status; regular office placement remained limited
records.durability_and_handoff: the school became an inherited baseline for later Mongol education, and the Confucian-household exemption/status system persisted through later Yuan; however the exam itself did not become a regular civil-service examination
records.cross_scene_replication: central school, realm-wide selection and scholar-status relief

counterevidence.summary: the central school was very small and the Wuxu selection did not establish a regular examination-to-office system; these cap CIV3 at LOW

records.inherited_baseline: 金亡与战争使华北典籍、学校和士人网络遭受严重破坏，蒙古国家尚无专门面向中原经史的整理机构
records.contemporary_feasible_frontier: 写本与早期木版环境下，征服政权可以保存部分文献，但设置跨地域专门机构持续搜集、编修经史仍需国家组织和资源
records.background_trend: 中原士人自发保存书籍是背景；只消费窝阔台政府接受耶律楚材建议后在燕京、平阳设专门机构的国家整理增量
records.attributable_change: 窝阔台朝在燕京设编修所、平阳设经籍所，召集儒者搜集、编修经史并保护中原典籍，使战争后的华北知识材料获得专门国家保存整理通道；相关机构和经籍整理成为后续蒙元文教恢复基础
records.field_coverage: two major North China institutional nodes for classics/history collection and compilation; wider public dissemination and print volume are not closed
records.durability_and_handoff: the institutions marked durable recognition of North China textual culture and supported later Yuan education, but direct mass dissemination is unproven
records.cross_scene_replication: Yanjing compilation office and Pingyang classics office

counterevidence.summary: detailed output quantities and broad readership are not closed, so the package stays CIV2-MID
